issue_context.title: Add dt.quarter_start, dt.quarter_end, dt.year_start and dt.year_end
issue_context.body:
### Description

I need date_range capabilities similar to pandas to conveniently get week, quarter, and year starts and ends.
I propose to implement quarter_start, quarter_end, year_start and year_end methods from pandas similarly to https://github.com/pola-rs/polars/pull/8435
PR for quarter and year implementation is: #14513
I will add tests and complete documentation once we discuss implementation details.

@mcrumiller and @MarcoGorelli could be interested as you were participating in the #8435
comments:
Discussed today - this would be good to have, isn't trivial for users to do themselves, and opens up for optimisation possibilities which might not be possible if users have to construct the result themselves

Looks like you've already opened a PR, feel free to ping when it's ready!

Thanks!
I will do refactoring and tests now

@mcrumiller @MarcoGorelli 
Refactoring, Tests and docs are done.
Few questions:

1. Wdyt about naming of 
`pub(crate) enum RollUnit {
    Month,
    Quarter,
    Year,
}` - maybe there is better fitting name?

2. Is my approach to the separation of roll_backward into the general function and supplementary ones for specific cases good enough? Or maybe better to use some different approach?  

Note: I changed module month_end, month_start to date_end, date_start so we could pack all end and start methods in there and not create new module for each new method.

PR #14513 was closed with the explanation that year_end is simple enough to do already

This is true, but in light of https://github.com/pola-rs/polars/issues/21183#issuecomment-2652696071, I think `quarter_end` would still be worth adding. Especially for financial quarters

This may need to come with some redesigning of the Polars string language - will get back to this, but it does seem quite valuable to address

From discussion today: OK to add `quarter_end`, possibly with `start_month` argument so you can specify e.g. financial quarters (dec-feb)

Implementation should share a fair bit with `month_end`, which #14513 did - I think that PR can probably be repurposed, but without `year_end` for now
